title: Phase 6 ingest throughput with stream routing
disposition: Routing overhead ~10-12% (per-message evaluation of 20 compiled condition trees + event_streams links). Gate met on the RFC path with 20 streams (6706). The vendor-extraction path is below the gate at baseline on this VM too (pre-existing P3-2); Phase 6 adds ~10% on top, it does not cause the shortfall.
carriedToPhase12: ≥ 5,000 msg/sec with vendor extraction AND 20 active streams, on clean-VM hardware (>2 GC cores, non-virtualised disk) — same carry as P1-1 and P3-2
